name: @willh/agentready
description: One JavaScript file that makes any website agent-ready: semantic HTML, forms, navigation and app state become safe, structured WebMCP tools.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build build/src/index.js --outfile dist/agentready.js --format=iife --target=browser && mkdir -p demo/store/vendor && cp dist/agentready.js demo/store/vendor/agentready.js && cp build/demo/store/app.js demo/store/app.js && cp build/demo/test-page/status.js demo/test-page/status.js
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run size
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run build:types && bun run build && bun run build:min && bun run test && bun run size && bun run test:e2e

author: Will Huang
